want: to select multiple transactions and change their category in one action
soThat: I can bulk-recategorize a batch of statement imports or miscategorized entries without editing each one individually
acceptance: while in the existing batch selection mode, a category picker and Apply button appear alongside the Delete action
choosing a category and pressing Apply updates the category of every selected transaction
the transaction list reflects the new category for all affected rows without a manual refresh
selection mode is exited after a successful batch category update
if the batch update fails, an error is shown and the transactions keep their original category
